notes:
v1.2.0 — Vnext batch shipped.

DESKTOP:
• Bracket auto-sell safety net (force_close_stale_brackets) — if Alpaca's TP/SL didn't fire when price crosses the level (paper-trading gap fills), the bot now sends a manual market SELL the next cycle.
• MARKET CLOSED badge now red with a left-moving white shimmer; bot status dots enlarged 16→20 px.
• Softer green / red / orange palette (less neon).
• Corner buttons (Universe / Make Bot / Tools) aligned with the main tab row.
• ⓘ hover tooltips on every account-summary + risk-metric card explaining how each number is computed and over what time frame.
• Equity charts now skip non-market hours (Plotly rangebreaks) — close-to-close lines, no more overnight flat segments.
• Position gauge on LONG / SHORT bots shows per-stock targets sized by each ticker's real 14-day ATR (cached) instead of a flat 2.5 % for every position.
• MAKE BOT tab gains an 'Improve existing bot' mode: pick any built-in or custom bot and describe the changes you want; the AI rewrites the file with the existing source as context.
• MAKE BOT tab gains a Free (via APEX) provider — no API key needed, routes through the APEX server's pooled Claude Haiku with a per-user rate limit. Purple→green FREE badge.

PHONE / WEB:
• iPhone status-bar fix: theme-color meta + viewport-fit=cover + safe-area-inset CSS — no more white bars next to the camera notch.
• Tap any bot card to expand a detail panel showing every open position with its individual P/L.
• Liquidate confirmation now states exactly how many positions will be closed.
• Period selector (Today / 1 Week / 1 Month) on the summary card; 1W and 1M pull from Alpaca's portfolio history.
• Phone status dots enlarged 8→12 px.

SERVER:
• New endpoints: GET /web/api/bots/{side}/positions, GET /web/api/portfolio/history, POST /api/makebot/generate (pooled Haiku with 5/hr/user rate-limit).
• Fixed daybot rearm_orphaned_positions calling undefined collect_candidate_data — now correctly calls analyse_stock.
